info.name: Sword Burst
info.description: Sword Burst (Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide / Xanathar's Guide) — added locally, not part of the core 2024 pack.
info.author: Falling-Cats

element.name: Sword Burst
element.supports: Artificer, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard, Damaging Spell, Spell Saving Throw

description.p: You create a burst of tandem chaos in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature in that area, other than you, must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Force damage and have disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

setters.set: emanation, dexterity, save, force, damage, upgrade
